visualReview.method: Manual view_image inspection of the generated real Canvas captures after this run
observations: The two unarmed walking contacts keep a consistent head/foot envelope in both orientations. Rest and reduced-motion fixtures retain the static standing pose.
Door frame and leaf use matching source coordinates; open bays stay visibly empty and foreground frames retain native attenuation.
Physical lamps remain attached in both orientations when on or off; the beam appears only when on. LUX indicators switch between the actual green and amber positions.
Both shutter controls remain present in open/closed/broken states. The native mechanism and its integrity/status presentation remain visible.
Six PNG effects are visible from native actions/state. The flame stream has no residual straight yellow tracer. Acid lies below the corpse; foam surrounds the restrained enemy base.
The six room captures retain native fallback adults/queen and world geometry where no corresponding PNG exists.
limits: Two walking key poses are not a complete locomotion animation cycle.
The isolated shutter fixture retains a small overlap between the native G/E prompt and status text; this text layout is inherited from the original renderer.
Armed poses still use the previously documented approximate secondary-hand composition; no complete firearm animation or canon fidelity is certified.
This remains real Canvas rendering of injected fixtures, not a browser interaction journey or campaign completion.
